create_flash_attention_impl: create a FlashAttentionImpl instance with num_heads, head_size, causal flag, and softmax_scale for attention computation
build_flash_attention_metadata: build FlashAttentionMetadata containing max sequence lengths and cumulative sequence length tensors
run_flash_attention_forward: run flash attention forward pass with query, key, value tensors and optional return_softmax_lse flag
set_flash_attention_version: set the flash attention version (3 or 4) to select between python function or custom op dispatch
test_flash_attention_fake_out: test flash attention fake out functions that return fixed tensor schemas for tracing and schema validation
